svg.title: Flowchart
svg.desc: Flowchart with 13 nodes and 12 edges. Nodes: Lane job reaches an end, Completed with exit 0, the verified digest equals the allowlisted one, and a val…, passed, failed, timed-out: the job ran past its budget, refused: no verdict, e.g. sha not on the remote, launcher 429, digest mismatch, Cancelled?, cancelled, cancel-unconfirmed: container and checkout kept, start-unknown: the start may have happened, checkout kept, Lane still declared with the same command and image?, counts as proof at this sha, retired: no longer proof. Lane job reaches an end leads to Completed with exit 0, the verified digest equals the allowlisted one, and a val…; Completed with exit 0, the verified digest equals the allowlisted one, and a val… leads to passed labeled "yes"; Completed with exit 0, the verified digest equals the allowlisted one, and a val… leads to failed labeled "no: anything else that ended"; Lane job reaches an end leads to timed-out: the job ran past its budget; Lane job reaches an end leads to refused: no verdict, e.g. sha not on the remote, launcher 429, digest mismatch; Lane job reaches an end leads to Cancelled?; Cancelled? leads to cancelled labeled "stop and removal confirmed"; Cancelled? leads to cancel-unconfirmed: container and checkout kept labeled "stop or removal unknown"; Lane job reaches an end leads to start-unknown: the start may have happened, checkout kept; passed leads to Lane still declared with the same command and image?; Lane still declared with the same command and image? leads to counts as proof at this sha labeled "yes"; Lane still declared with the same command and image? leads to retired: no longer proof labeled "no".
